issues.problem: bad[1].why was garbled ('teaches towards me') and did not clearly say how to name the learner.
issues.action: Rewrote the why: no direct object; name the learner with 对 (dui wo) instead.

issues.problem: Story quoted Sun Tzu correctly but did not say that the original order in 《孙子兵法·谋攻》 is 知彼知己; the modern idiom reverses it.
issues.action: Added a note on the original order; story and source kept.

issues.problem: ctx[2] (只顾装修就本末倒置了) fitted the near-synonym 舍本逐末 just as well.
issues.action: Rewrote it so that the decor, a secondary thing, is treated as the main one, which points to an inverted order of importance.

issues.problem: ctx[5] (overtime pay leading to a hospital stay) fitted 得不偿失 just as well.
issues.action: Rewrote it with a clear small/big contrast: a little overtime pay against what matters most, his health.
